prompts.name: lamp-detail
prompts.prompt:
Create a production quality UI design for Eluno, Russian Android local smart home controller. This is an extension of the selected reference image, NOT a new visual direction. Precisely continue its Material 3 style: white #FFFBFE background, pale lavender #EADDFF active surfaces, purple #6750A4 controls, charcoal #211F26, gray #625B71, warm amber for warnings. Roboto typography, big bold titles, 24dp rounded independent surfaces, large circular power buttons, thin Material icons. Simple spacing, no heavy shadows. All Russian readable body 14-16dp, touch targets 48dp. No room management, cloud, login, routines, stats, weather or Google Home. Demo explicitly marked "Деморежим · данные имитируются". Device states separate confirmed from pending; unknown never means off. Only controls supported by device. Device names: Настольная лампа, Розетка в гостиной, Цветная лента, Недоступная розетка. Date anchor 31 Oct 2026 Europe/Moscow, no need for dates. One standalone screen only, edge to edge app content without bezel, device, OS status bar, notch, camera, navigation bar or explanatory labels. Use attached selected mock as visual source.
Draw the LAMP DETAIL screen, target 390 x 844 logical px. Back arrow at top left, title "Настольная лампа" below, small "Лампа · демоустройство" subtitle. Top-right three-dot menu. A generous lavender panel with lamp line icon at left, label "Питание", "Включено" and big circular purple power button right. Small line "Подтверждено только что". Under it, separated by generous whitespace rather than many cards, section "Яркость" with large 65% and horizontal purple slider, min 5% max100%. Next "Температура" and 3 200 K with slider on a pale neutral track at mathematically correct 13% of range, warm icon left and cool icon right, limits 2 700 K and 6 500 K. Do not use rainbow color control on lamp. Bottom buttons "Обновить" and "Переименовать" clear 48dp. Small "Деморежим · данные имитируются" footer. Refined, spacious, exact continuation of reference.
